mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_run_submission WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run_submission SET started=TRUE,lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{leaseMicros},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND started=FALSE

UPDATE agent_run_submission SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{leaseMicros},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_state r WHERE r.run_id=#{runId} AND r.status='RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_submission s JOIN agent_run_state r ON r.run_id=s.run_id WHERE s.run_id=#{runId} AND s.lease_owner=#{owner} AND s.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND r.status='RUNNING')
SELECT status FROM agent_run_state WHERE run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_submission WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_submission WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
SELECT FROM agent_run_submission WHERE run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run_submission SET event_count=event_count+1,event_bytes=event_bytes+#{bytes} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND event_count < 8192 AND event_bytes+#{bytes} <= 2097152
mapper.select: SELECT id,payload FROM agent_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 128
SELECT s.run_id FROM agent_run_submission s JOIN agent_run_state r ON r.run_id=s.run_id WHERE s.started=FALSE AND r.status='CREATED' ORDER BY s.created_at,s.run_id LIMIT 50
SELECT run_id FROM agent_run_submission WHERE lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY lease_until,run_id LIMIT 50
SELECT run_id FROM agent_run_submission WHERE events_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY events_expires_at,run_id LIMIT 10
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId} LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run_submission SET events_expires_at=NULL WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId})
